description: This file defines the ClaimAttachmentDecorator class within the OrangeHRM project. It acts as a decorator for ClaimAttachment entities, providing additional methods and traits for handling user references and attachment data streams.

classes.name: ClaimAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for ClaimAttachment entities providing methods to handle attachment data and associate users.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a ClaimAttachment entity.

methods.name: setUserByUserId
methods.description: Sets the user of the claim attachment based on a user ID.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the attachment content as a string, reading from a stream if necessary.
